video_title: Training Camp Media Availability (10/01/26) | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Kobe Brown's demeanor and basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing he learns quickly, he learns from his mistakes, he understands what we're doing
quotes.quote: Just his demeanor, I think. He doesn't get rattled. He can miss shots and still be ready to shoot the basketball. The biggest thing he learns quickly, he learns from his mistakes, he understands what we're doing both offensively and defensively, and so he's very bright.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue praises Kobe Brown for his composure and basketball IQ, noting that he does not get rattled and learns quickly from his mistakes.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the team's initial starting five
quotes.excerpt: it's been Darius, Max, Rui, D.J., and Isaiah
quotes.quote: To start it's been Darius, Max, Rui, D.J., and Isaiah.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue reveals the initial starting five for the Clippers at training camp: Darius, Max, Rui, D.J., and Isaiah.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on his defensive focus during training camp
quotes.excerpt: I've been trying to guard Darius every time I can
quotes.quote: It's all just effort on that side of the ball, the one-two, and that's been my main focus is trying to guard the best player each time I'm out here. So I've been trying to guard Darius every time I can and J.B. has been having me try to pick up full court just to do that. Another thing for me is just trying to cause steals when I'm off the ball. So that's been a big emphasis for me on the defensive end.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says his main focus at training camp is defensive effort, specifically trying to guard the best player on the floor and picking up full court.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the team's point guard play
quotes.excerpt: he's pushed all of us, he's always working hard, getting up extra shots
quotes.quote: He's been really good. He's pushed all of us, I'd say. He's always working hard, getting up extra shots, putting in the extra work, and just out here you can tell that he's comfortable. He's making the right play, knocking down shots, and he's playing as hard as he can, especially on the defensive end. He's trying to guard people full court, creates steals, and he's been super good for us.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says the team's point guard play has been really good, noting that he is comfortable, making the right plays, and working hard on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on the intensity of training camp
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we're iron sharpening iron right now, going against each other every single day
quotes.quote: It's been great. I feel like we're iron sharpening iron right now, going against each other every single day, and it's only building to day three. From what I can hear, this is going to be the hardest day, so we got to just keep pushing and we've been competing, like I said, and I think that's just going to take us as far as we want to go.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland describes the intensity of Clippers training camp as iron sharpening iron, emphasizing the importance of competing every single day.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on the team's next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: knowing kind of a next-man-up mentality with whoever it is
quotes.quote: I think it's just knowing kind of a next-man-up mentality with whoever it is. Unfortunately, that's kind of what basketball can be like for different teams, and that's why you see the teams that kind of make it very far, kind of stay healthier, I guess. And then at the end of the day, playing hard solves a lot of that. My mindset is kind of the same coming into any team I'm on, and that's just figuring out my role right away and trying to be the best I can be personally and then ultimately helping the team in that way.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland discusses the next man up mentality, stating that his focus is on figuring out his role immediately to help the team in any way possible.
